@Hambones82 this is one example of stuff that's off in OpenApoc that may be related to the way ticks are dealt with

I have spoken with you regarding #997 about such things before, but had forgotten that explosion size and intensity (both with the "Explosions damage instantly" fix on or off under more options) are way off compared to OG despite using the same values in the XML

It's possible that ticks come into play here, but I think it's more complicated than just ticks.  I think often there are hard coded values that are off or the implementation of explosion/smoke could be off as well.

Most certainly, the weapon stats are largely correct (I've found very few errors - security stations being the only ones I ca recall off the top of my head)

But for hardcoded stuff in the calculations, particularly if derived from Wong's Guide (who has a rep for being "close but not correct" with some of his stuff), i suspect could be rather off

Now that you mentioned it, I did turn on the "Explosions damage instantly" option. I will turn that off and see if it changes anything.
#1336 is also a discrepancy of the MAC HE that is very annoying.

resource.body:
- OS: Windows 11 Pro 22H2
- OpenApoc Version: 0.0.728
- List of Mod files in use: None

First of all, I want to give a big thank you to all of you who help to develop OpenApoc.

Now to the discrepancies with the Megapol Auto Cannon, MAC for short, especially the High Explosive Ammo, HE for short.

When you start a new game in OpenApoc, about two of your soldiers have the MAC equipped, but somehow they have random ammo types preloaded in the gun. In the original game (OG/vanilla), the MACs always come preloaded with Armor Piercing bullets (AP).

The visible blast radius of the MAC HE Ammo is five squares in the original game and damages enemies a short distance from the visible blast zone as well. In OpenApoc, the visible blast radius is fifteen squares, and the blast creates smoke clouds that linger on, just like a Smoke Grenade does. The MAC HE Ammo also feels weaker, especially against the Multiworm. I don't know if it is because of the difficulty level. I game on Medium difficulty nowadays. Back in the day, I would always play on the Novice difficulty level. I used to blast open a Multiworm in 3 to 5 shots of HE ammo, only to finish off all four of its Hyperworm spawns in one well-aimed HE bullet shot. Now the Multiworm seems invulnerable to the MAC HE ammo. Other enemies seem to die as expected on Medium difficulty with MAC HE ammo. Spitters usually die after two, and Brainsuckers die after one (usually).

**To Reproduce**
Just compare it between the OG and OpenApoc.

**Expected behavior**
It should be as OG Vanilla.

**Copy of your OpenApoc_settings.conf**
I haven't messed with any settings that should affect any of this.

Edit: I did turn on the "Explosions damage instantly" "fix" 😅
